escape_underscores off leaves underscores in a table cell unescaped while escape_asterisks still applies

```rust title="Rust"
use html_to_markdown_rs::convert;
use html_to_markdown_rs::ConversionOptions;

fn main() {
    let html = r#"<table><tr><td>sample_value 2*3</td></tr></table>"#;
    let options_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"escape_asterisks":true,"escape_underscores":false}"#).unwrap();
    let options: ConversionOptions = serde_json::from_value(options_json).unwrap();
    let result = convert(html, Some(options.clone())).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.content);
}
```
